besluite.rede: Calling 'hoog of laag' one of the sorting questions is acceptable shorthand that follows on naturally from the sentences before it, and the proposal adds quotation marks and a question mark to a lesson that holds no questions, so it is only a different way of saying the same thing and adds clutter.

besluite.fout: 'n liniaal oor 'n tafelrand' is compressed: it does not say that part of the ruler sticks out, which is what 'n korter stuk' refers to.
besluite.rede: Saying that the ruler sticks out over the table edge makes the familiar demonstration clear to a Grade 4 reader, and it keeps the same preposition, the same claim and the same subject.
